accuracy: Every method must certify its own coefficient, tail, financial-grid, auxiliary-grid, table/arithmetic and estimation error. A proposed width is not an attained tolerance.

zero_quantum_decision: Apply equally supplied whole-correction and full classical price certificates before selecting quantum estimation. Retain hypothetical forced quantum budgets separately.
retention: All 27 synthetic cases and every rejected configuration retained. No favourable case removal or empirical market-validation claim.
priority: No new quantum algorithm or theoretical priority claim is inferred from composition. Stable divided-difference competitors remain relevant if onlyrawsubtractionisimplemented.
